title: Cross-Region DNS Migration
description: Migrate primary DNS records from us-east-1 to eu-west-1: lower TTL, update records, monitor traffic shift, verify failover

steps.description: Provision eu-west-1 infrastructure (ALB, target groups) mirroring us-east-1; validate health checks pass
Reduce Route53 TTL from 300s to 60s for all migrating records; wait for full propagation
Add eu-west-1 ALB DNS as primary record; keep us-east-1 as secondary (failover routing)
Monitor traffic shift: DNS queries resolving to eu-west-1, request counts ramping up, error rates stable
Simulate us-east-1 health check failure; verify traffic automatically shifts to eu-west-1 within DNS TTL window
Run end-to-end tests from multiple regions; confirm latency reduction, zero errors, DNS consistency
Restore us-east-1 as primary, remove eu-west-1 from Route53, restore TTL to original value

checks: All DNS queries resolve to eu-west-1 ALB from 3+ geographic regions
Health checks for both regions pass
Failover test completes in < 120s (2x TTL window)
P99 latency from eu-west-1 is lower than us-east-1 for EU clients
Zero 5xx errors during and after migration
verification.success_criteria: 100% traffic served from eu-west-1 with automated failover working and latency SLA met

rollback_plan.trigger_condition: Error rate increases > 0.5% OR failover test fails OR latency regression > 10%
steps: Update Route53 records: us-east-1 primary, eu-west-1 secondary
Confirm DNS resolves to us-east-1 globally
Verify error rate returns to baseline
